messages:

Subject: Reseller addendum — sequencing & evidence handoff

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for taking this. Attached is our draft of the reseller addendum with a few redlines we need to push through for the CloudRetail marketplace listing. Two asks from procurement: 1) can you confirm which party will own audit evidence retention for resale transactions, and 2) we need an operations contact for invoicing reconciliation queries post-go-live.

I've attached the redlined doc and an evidence checklist. Our timeline is tight: we'd like legal sign-off by next Thursday (Aug 28) so we can schedule listing for Sept 8. Can you confirm next steps and who on your side will coordinate the DocuSign flow?

Best,
Avery

Subject: Re: Reseller addendum — sequencing & evidence handoff

Hi Avery — thanks for sending these over. Looping in Ben (partner ops) and Marissa (legal lead) to take the redlines and evidence checklist. Quick answers up front:

- Audit evidence retention: Redwood can retain logs for 12 months by default; ops can accept a passthrough where CloudRetail keeps a copy of final invoices. If the customer requires longer retention tied to marketplace reporting, that'll need a clause (see Marissa's question below).
- Invoicing recon contact: Ben will be the day-to-day contact for reconciliations and templating.
- DocuSign: we typically run the final order form through legal's DocuSign workflow — Marissa will confirm sign-off owner and provide link.

Ben / Marissa / Laura — can you review Avery's redlines and the attached checklist? If legal has carve-outs (e.g., revenue pass-through or audit trigger thresholds) please call them out in the tracker and propose language. I copied Laura to coordinate any procurement gating from our finance side.

Cheers,
Jasmine
Director, Partner Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reseller addendum — sequencing & evidence handoff

Thanks — quick ops note.

I reviewed the evidence checklist. Operationally we can:
- Provide per-order invoice metadata and a monthly reconciliation CSV export (see attached redline_tracker for required fields).
- Accept a pass-through arrangement for the listing fees but need clear invoicing waterfall in the order form (which itemizes marketplace fees vs subscription).
- For audit evidence requests from CloudRetail customers, we require a 72-hour SLA to surface logs and will keep an audit request log. Anything beyond that (e.g., continuous retention longer than 12 months) triggers procurement review.

Action items for this thread (ops):
1) Ben to supply reconciliations sample CSV and field mapping to CloudRetail (ETA EOD Tues).
2) Jasmine to confirm timeline for legal redlines.
3) Laura to check finance constraints on pass-through settlement timing.

Attachment: redline_tracker_20260822.xlsx

-Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reseller addendum — sequencing & evidence handoff

Jasmine / team — I reviewed the CloudRetail redlines and drafted counter-language. High-level legal points:

1) Indemnity/ liability cap: propose retaining the standard MSA cap but add a carve-out for willful misconduct and a marketplace-specific audit indemnity up to $250k.
2) Evidence retention & audit scope: we can agree to provide invoice-level data and limited logs for 12 months; anything longer needs a commercial add-on. Marissa (legal) notes: we should add explicit language limiting the use of logs to audit/reconciliation purposes only.
3) Pass-through fees & payment waterfall: redline includes a settlement schedule (Net 30 to Redwood, Redwood pays CloudRetail their share within 15 days after payment receipt). Finance okayed a 15-day pay-down but wants to confirm currency and withholding tax clauses.
4) Audit triggers: require a materiality threshold (e.g., $50k disputed ARR) before Redwood must produce full audit evidence to avoid constant audits.

I've updated the attached doc with inline comments and added an excel tracker row for each legal ask. Please review and flag anything operationally infeasible. I can finalize wording and spin DocuSign envelope once we converge.

Next: Ben — confirm the reconciliations sample and the exact CSV columns Marissa referenced. Laura — please confirm finance won't block the 15-day settlement.

- Marissa
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference

From: Avery Cloud <avery@cloudretail.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudretail.com
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reseller addendum — sequencing & evidence handoff

Jasmine / team — thanks, this is helpful. A few quick clarifications from procurement after reading Marissa's notes:

- The $50k materiality threshold is acceptable.
- CloudRetail prefers invoice-level retention for 24 months; can Redwood confirm a priced add-on for extended retention? If so, procurement will need a short SOW or orderform line item for extended logs.
- For DocuSign, procurement will sign as soon as the final order form is provided. Please also include the marketplace listing effective date field in the order form (we want to coordinate the Sept 8 target).

We'll hold on final signatures until we see the revised order form and the settlement waterfall language. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Avery

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
